notes: Squeak and Pharo have shipped a versions browser since the 1980s. This image has carried the chain since 5.129.0 — every commit with its source, its author, its actor kind and its why — and the browser showed a count. THE GAP WAS MEASURED AGAINST THE EMITTED DOCUMENT, which is also how the audit that found it corrected itself: in the browser's own 51,537-character region the only "version" was v + a count in a class-row tooltip, and the only revert was the editor's ⟳ Revert, whose own tooltip reads *"discard the buffer"*.
